observation.visible_scene: A single female dancer stands centered in a bright studio with a white wall of fine vertical stripes and a plain gray floor. She wears a tight beige mini dress, a short white jacket/cardigan, and white boots. Her legs stay crossed at the knee throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-4) her elbows are bent with hands raised near shoulder level, palms turned inward/up.
From frames 5 to 16 the arms progressively open outward and upward until both arms are extended to the sides at roughly shoulder height with palms facing forward.
In frames 17-22 the extended arms remain horizontal but the wrists rotate so the fingers point downward.
In frames 23-26 the arms swing downward toward the hips, with visible motion blur indicating a faster movement.
In frames 27-31 the hands continue descending to around thigh level.
From frames 32 to 41 the arms draw inward and the hands come together in front of the lower body, held near the crotch/upper-thigh area.
The torso and knees dip slightly lower toward the end (compare head height in frame 1 vs frame 41), giving a small squat/lean while the crossed-leg stance is maintained.
The striped background does not shift across frames, indicating a static camera with no pan/zoom; all apparent motion is the dancer's own.
outside_clip_unknowns: The clip begins and ends mid-routine, so the move that preceded frame 1 and the move that follows frame 41 are not shown.
No audio, rhythm cues, or other performers are visible to confirm timing or context.
uncertain_details: Exact hand/finger orientation is hard to read in low-resolution frames, especially during the blurred downward swing (frames 23-26).
Whether the slight body lowering is a deliberate squat or just a change in posture is not fully determinable.
The precise degree of head tilt varies but is minor and not a clear separate motion.
